import { motion, AnimatePresence } from "framer-motion";
import { Search, Filter, X, Sparkles } from "lucide-react";
import { useAppState } from "../../hooks/useAppState";
import { useHistory } from "../../hooks/useHistory";
import { PORTFOLIO_DATA } from "../../data/portfolioData";
import ProjectCard from "./ProjectCard";
import FittsButton from "../interaction/FittsButton";

export default function ProjectGrid() {
  const {
    searchQuery,
    setSearchQuery,
    activeCategory,
    setActiveCategory,
    activeTags,
    toggleTag,
    clearFilters,
  } = useAppState();
  const { pushState } = useHistory();

  // Extract unique categories
  const categories = [
    "All",
    ...Array.from(new Set(PORTFOLIO_DATA.projects.map((p) => p.category))),
  ];

  // Extract all unique tags
  const allTags = Array.from(
    new Set(PORTFOLIO_DATA.projects.flatMap((p) => p.tags))
  );

  // Filtered projects computation
  const filteredProjects = PORTFOLIO_DATA.projects.filter((project) => {
    // 1. Category filter
    if (activeCategory && project.category !== activeCategory) {
      return false;
    }

    // 2. Search query filter
    if (searchQuery.trim()) {
      const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
      const matchTitle = project.title.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      const matchSummary = project.summary.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      const matchCategory = project.category.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      const matchTags = project.tags.some((t) => t.toLowerCase().includes(q));

      if (!matchTitle && !matchSummary && !matchCategory && !matchTags) {
        return false;
      }
    }

    // 3. Active tags filter (must contain all active tags)
    if (activeTags.length > 0) {
      const hasAllTags = activeTags.every((tag) => project.tags.includes(tag));
      if (!hasAllTags) {
        return false;
      }
    }

    return true;
  });

  const handleCategorySelect = (category: string) => {
    pushState(`Filter by ${category}`);
    setActiveCategory(category === "All" ? null : category);
  };

  const handleSearchChange = (val: string) => {
    setSearchQuery(val);
  };

  const hasFilters =
    Boolean(searchQuery) || Boolean(activeCategory) || activeTags.length > 0;

  return (
    <section id="projects" className="py-24 max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
      {/* Section Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-end justify-between gap-4 mb-10 pb-6 border-b border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-800">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 font-semibold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">
            <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Featured Technical Work</span>
          </div>
          <h2 className="text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-extrabold text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100 tracking-tight">
            Projects &amp; Systems
          </h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 mt-2 max-w-2xl leading-relaxed">
            Hands-on implementations in game-tree search algorithms, neural networks, image segmentation pipelines, and database management systems.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Total Count Badge */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 self-start md:self-auto">
          <span>Showing</span>
          <span className="font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800 border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700">
            {filteredProjects.length} of {PORTFOLIO_DATA.projects.length}
          </span>
          <span>projects</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Control Bar: Categories + Search */}
      <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between gap-4 mb-8">
        {/* Category Filter Pills */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto pb-1 scrollbar-none">
          {categories.map((category) => {
            const isSelected =
              (category === "All" && activeCategory === null) ||
              activeCategory === category;

            return (
              <button
                key={category}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleCategorySelect(category)}
                className={`px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium transition-all cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 ${
                  isSelected
                    ? "bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-xs"
                    : "bg-gray-100 hover:bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-800 dark:hover:bg-gray-700 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400"
                }`}
              >
                {category}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        {/* Global Search Input */}
        <div className="relative w-full lg:w-80">
          <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-gray-400 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none" />
          <input
            id="search-input"
            type="text"
            value={searchQuery}
            onChange={(e) => handleSearchChange(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Search keywords, tech stack, tags..."
            className="w-full pl-9 pr-14 py-2 text-xs rounded-xl bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-900 border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-800 text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100 placeholder-gray-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:bg-white dark:focus:bg-gray-950 transition-colors"
          />
          <kbd className="hidden sm:inline-block font-mono text-[10px] bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 text-gray-400 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none">
            /
          </kbd>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Available Tags Filter Bar */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-8 flex-wrap">
        <span className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 font-medium flex items-center gap-1">
          <Filter className="w-3 h-3" /> Filter by tag:
        </span>
        {allTags.map((tag) => {
          const isActive = activeTags.includes(tag);
          return (
            <button
              key={tag}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                pushState(`Toggle #${tag}`);
                toggleTag(tag);
              }}
              className={`text-[11px] px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer border ${
                isActive
                  ? "bg-blue-600 text-white border-blue-600 shadow-xs"
                  : "bg-white dark:bg-gray-900 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-800 hover:border-gray-300 dark:hover:border-gray-700"
              }`}
            >
              #{tag}
            </button>
          );
        })}

        {hasFilters && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={clearFilters}
            className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 hover:text-red-500 flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer ml-2 focus:outline-none"
          >
            <X className="w-3 h-3" />
            Reset all
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Projects Grid Container */}
      {filteredProjects.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="py-16 text-center rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-800 p-8 space-y-4">
          <p className="text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 text-sm">
            No projects match your current search and filter criteria.
          </p>
          <FittsButton priority="secondary" onClick={clearFilters} icon={<X className="w-4 h-4" />}>
            Clear All Active Filters
          </FittsButton>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <motion.div layout className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
          <AnimatePresence>
            {filteredProjects.map((project) => (
              <ProjectCard key={project.id} project={project} />
            ))}
          </AnimatePresence>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs mb-1.5">

                      <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-500 opacity-80" />
                      {skill.name}
                    </span>
                    <span className="font-mono text-gray-400">{skill.proficiency}%</span>
                  </div>

                  {/* Accessible Proficiency Progress Bar */}
                  <div
                    role="progressbar"
                    aria-valuenow={skill.proficiency}
                    aria-valuemin={0}
                    aria-valuemax={100}
                    aria-label={`${skill.name} proficiency`}
                    className="h-2 w-full bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-full overflow-hidden"
                  >
                    <motion.div
                      initial={{ width: 0 }}
                      whileInView={{ width: `${skill.proficiency}%` }}
                      viewport={{ once: true }}
                      transition={{ duration: 0.9, ease: "easeOut" }}
                      className="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-500 to-indigo-600 rounded-full"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

import { motion } from "framer-motion";
import { ArrowDown, Network, Layers, GitCommit } from "lucide-react";
import type { WorkModel } from "../../types";

interface WorkModelViewerProps {
  model: WorkModel;
}

export default function WorkModelViewer({ model }: WorkModelViewerProps) {
  const getModelIcon = (type: WorkModel["type"]) => {
    switch (type) {
      case "flow":
        return <Network className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-500" />;
      case "sequence":
        return <GitCommit className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-500" />;
      case "artifact":
        return <Layers className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-500" />;
    }
  };

  const getModelBadge = (type: WorkModel["type"]) => {
    switch (type) {
      case "flow":
        return "Pipeline & Architecture Flow";
      case "sequence":
        return "Execution Sequence";
      case "artifact":
        return "Structural Component Model";
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-800 bg-white/50 dark:bg-gray-900/50 p-5 shadow-xs space-y-4">
      {/* Header */}
      <div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
          {getModelIcon(model.type)}
          <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
            {getModelBadge(model.type)}
          </span>
        </div>
        <h4 className="text-base font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100">
          {model.title}
        </h4>
        <p className="text-xs text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 mt-1 leading-relaxed">
          {model.description}
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Model Steps Flow */}
      <div className="space-y-2 pt-2">
        {model.steps.map((step, index) => {
          const isLast = index === model.steps.length - 1;

          return (
            <div key={index} className="flex flex-col items-center sm:items-start">
              <motion.div
                initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
                whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                viewport={{ once: true }}
                transition={{ delay: index * 0.08, duration: 0.3 }}
                className="w-full flex items-start gap-3 p-3 rounded-lg bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800/60 border border-gray-200/70 dark:border-gray-700/60"
              >
                <div className="w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-900/60 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 font-mono text-xs font-semibold flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 mt-0.5">
                  {index + 1}
                </div>
                <div className="text-xs text-gray-800 dark:text-gray-200 leading-relaxed font-medium">
                  {step}
                </div>
              </motion.div>

              {!isLast && (
                <div className="py-1 text-gray-400 dark:text-gray-600 pl-4 flex items-center gap-1">
                  <ArrowDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-mono tracking-wider opacity-70">
                    Proceeds to
                  </span>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

src\context\HistoryContext.tsx begins here
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
import { useState, useCallback, type ReactNode } from "react";
import type { HistoryEntry } from "../types";
import { useAppState } from "../hooks/useAppState";
import { HistoryContext, type HistoryContextType } from "./HistoryContextDefinition";

export function HistoryProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const { searchQuery, activeCategory, activeTags, setFilterState } = useAppState();
  const [past, setPast] = useState<HistoryEntry[]>([]);
  const [future, setFuture] = useState<HistoryEntry[]>([]);

  const pushState = useCallback(
    (label: string, _nextState?: HistoryEntry["state"]) => {
      setPast((prev) => [
        ...prev,
        {
          label,
          state: {
            searchQuery,
            activeCategory,
            activeTags: [...activeTags],
          },
        },
      ]);
      setFuture([]);
    },
    [searchQuery, activeCategory, activeTags]
  );

  const undo = useCallback(() => {
    setPast((prevPast) => {
      if (prevPast.length === 0) return prevPast;
      const previous = prevPast[prevPast.length - 1];
      const newPast = prevPast.slice(0, prevPast.length - 1);

      setFuture((prevFuture) => [
        {
          label: "Undone state",
          state: {
            searchQuery,
            activeCategory,
            activeTags: [...activeTags],
          },
        },
        ...prevFuture,
      ]);

      setFilterState(previous.state);
      return newPast;
    });
  }, [searchQuery, activeCategory, activeTags, setFilterState]);

  const redo = useCallback(() => {
    setFuture((prevFuture) => {
      if (prevFuture.length === 0) return prevFuture;
      const next = prevFuture[0];
      const newFuture = prevFuture.slice(1);

      setPast((prevPast) => [
        ...prevPast,
        {
          label: "Redone state",
          state: {
            searchQuery,
            activeCategory,
            activeTags: [...activeTags],
          },
        },
      ]);

      setFilterState(next.state);
      return newFuture;
    });
  }, [searchQuery, activeCategory, activeTags, setFilterState]);

  const value: HistoryContextType = {
    past,
    future,
    pushState,
    undo,
    redo,
    canUndo: past.length > 0,
    canRedo: future.length > 0,
  };

  return <HistoryContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</HistoryContext.Provider>;
}

import { createContext } from "react";
import type { HistoryEntry } from "../types";

export interface HistoryContextType {
  past: HistoryEntry[];
  future: HistoryEntry[];
  pushState: (label: string, filterState?: HistoryEntry["state"]) => void;
  undo: () => void;
  redo: () => void;
  canUndo: boolean;
  canRedo: boolean;
}

export const HistoryContext = createContext<HistoryContextType | undefined>(undefined);

src\context\StateContext.tsx begins here
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
import { useState, useEffect, type ReactNode } from "react";
import type { AppState } from "../types";
import { StateContext, type StateContextType } from "./StateContextDefinition";

export function StateProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>("");
  const [activeCategory, setActiveCategory] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [activeTags, setActiveTags] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [isDarkMode, setIsDarkMode] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [activeModal, setActiveModal] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isCommandPaletteOpen, setIsCommandPaletteOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [scrollProgress, setScrollProgress] = useState<number>(0);

  // Sync dark mode class on document element
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isDarkMode) {
      document.documentElement.classList.add("dark");
    } else {
      document.documentElement.classList.remove("dark");
    }
  }, [isDarkMode]);

  const toggleTag = (tag: string) => {
    setActiveTags((prev) =>
      prev.includes(tag) ? prev.filter((t) => t !== tag) : [...prev, tag]
    );
  };

  const clearFilters = () => {
    setSearchQuery("");
    setActiveCategory(null);
    setActiveTags([]);
  };

  const toggleDarkMode = () => {
    setIsDarkMode((prev) => !prev);
  };

  const openModal = (projectId: string) => {
    setActiveModal(projectId);
  };

  const closeModal = () => {
    setActiveModal(null);
  };

  const toggleCommandPalette = () => {
    setIsCommandPaletteOpen((prev) => !prev);
  };

  const setFilterState = (state: Pick<AppState, "searchQuery" | "activeCategory" | "activeTags">) => {
    setSearchQuery(state.searchQuery);
    setActiveCategory(state.activeCategory);
    setActiveTags(state.activeTags);
  };

  const value: StateContextType = {
    searchQuery,
    activeCategory,
    activeTags,
    isDarkMode,
    activeModal,
    isCommandPaletteOpen,
    scrollProgress,
    setSearchQuery,
    setActiveCategory,
    toggleTag,
    clearFilters,
    toggleDarkMode,
    openModal,
    closeModal,
    toggleCommandPalette,
    setScrollProgress,
    setFilterState,
  };

  return <StateContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</StateContext.Provider>;
}

import { createContext } from "react";
import type { AppState } from "../types";

export interface StateContextType extends AppState {
  setSearchQuery: (query: string) => void;
  setActiveCategory: (category: string | null) => void;
  toggleTag: (tag: string) => void;
  clearFilters: () => void;
  toggleDarkMode: () => void;
  openModal: (projectId: string) => void;
  closeModal: () => void;
  toggleCommandPalette: () => void;
  setScrollProgress: (progress: number) => void;
  setFilterState: (state: Pick<AppState, "searchQuery" | "activeCategory" | "activeTags">) => void;
}

export const StateContext = createContext<StateContextType | undefined>(undefined);

import { useContext } from "react";
import { StateContext, type StateContextType } from "../context/StateContextDefinition";

export function useAppState(): StateContextType {
  const context = useContext(StateContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error("useAppState must be used within a StateProvider");
  }
  return context;
}

src\hooks\useFittsTarget.ts begins here

import type { CSSProperties } from "react";

export type FittsPriority = "primary" | "secondary" | "tertiary";

export interface FittsTargetStyle {
  minWidth: string;
  minHeight: string;
  padding: string;
}

export function useFittsTarget(priority: FittsPriority = "secondary"): {
  style: CSSProperties;
} {
  const sizes: Record<FittsPriority, FittsTargetStyle> = {
    primary: { minWidth: "56px", minHeight: "56px", padding: "14px 28px" },
    secondary: { minWidth: "48px", minHeight: "48px", padding: "12px 24px" },
    tertiary: { minWidth: "40px", minHeight: "40px", padding: "10px 20px" },
  };

  return { style: sizes[priority] };
}

import { useContext } from "react";
import { HistoryContext, type HistoryContextType } from "../context/HistoryContextDefinition";

export function useHistory(): HistoryContextType {
  const context = useContext(HistoryContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error(
      "useHistory must be used within a HistoryProvider (wrapped inside StateProvider)"
    );
  }
  return context;
}

src\hooks\useKeyboardShortcuts.ts begins here

import { useEffect } from "react";
import { useAppState } from "./useAppState";
import { useHistory } from "./useHistory";

export function useKeyboardShortcuts() {
  const {
    toggleCommandPalette,
    closeModal,
    clearFilters,
    activeModal,
    isCommandPaletteOpen,
  } = useAppState();
  const { undo, redo } = useHistory();

  useEffect(() => {
    const handler = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      const target = e.target as HTMLElement | null;
      const isInput =
        target &&
        (target.tagName === "INPUT" ||
          target.tagName === "TEXTAREA" ||
          target.isContentEditable);

      const mod = e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey;

      // Ctrl/Cmd + K: Toggle Command Palette
      if (mod && e.key.toLowerCase() === "k") {
        e.preventDefault();
        toggleCommandPalette();
        return;
      }

      // Escape: Close active modal -> Close Command Palette -> Clear filters
      if (e.key === "Escape") {
        if (activeModal) {
          closeModal();
        } else if (isCommandPaletteOpen) {
          toggleCommandPalette();
        } else {
          clearFilters();
        }
        return;
      }

      // Ctrl/Cmd + Shift + Z: Redo
      if (mod && e.shiftKey && e.key.toLowerCase() === "z") {
        e.preventDefault();
        redo();
        return;
      }

      // Ctrl/Cmd + Z: Undo
      if (mod && e.key.toLowerCase() === "z") {
        e.preventDefault();
        undo();
        return;
      }

      // / : Focus global search input when not typing in an input
      if (e.key === "/" && !mod && !isInput) {
        e.preventDefault();
        const searchInput = document.getElementById("search-input");
        if (searchInput) {
          searchInput.focus();
        }
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener("keydown", handler);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handler);
  }, [
    activeModal,
    isCommandPaletteOpen,
    toggleCommandPalette,
    closeModal,
    clearFilters,
    undo,
    redo,
  ]);
}

// ── Personal Info ──
export interface PersonalInfo {
  name: string;
  role: string;
  tagline: string;
  about: string;
  resumeUrl?: string;
}

// ── Skills ──
export interface SkillCategory {
  category: string;
  items: SkillItem[];
}

export interface SkillItem {
  name: string;
  proficiency: number; // 0–100
}

// ── HCI Artifacts ──
export interface ContextualInquiryFinding {
  participant: string;
  observation: string;
  designImplication: string;
}

export interface AffinityNode {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  theme: string;       // grouping theme name
  color: string;       // hex color for the theme
}

export interface WorkModel {
  type: "flow" | "sequence" | "artifact";
  title: string;
  description: string;
  steps: string[];      // ordered list of steps/nodes
}

export interface GOMSAnalysis {
  taskName: string;
  predictedTimeMs: number;
  actualTimeMs: number;
  operators: string[];   // list of GOMS operators
}

export interface FittsLawData {
  taskName: string;
  targetWidthPx: number;
  distancePx: number;
  indexOfDifficulty: number;  // log2(2D / W)
  measuredTimeMs: number;
}

// ── Projects / Case Studies ──
export interface ProjectLink {
  label: string;       // e.g. "Live Demo", "GitHub", "Figma Prototype"
  url: string;
}

export interface Project {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  role: string;         // e.g. "Lead UX Researcher"
  category: string;     // e.g. "HCI Research", "Interaction Design"
  summary: string;
  tags: string[];
  details: {
    problem: string;
    solution: string;
    heuristicsApplied: string[];
  };
  contextualInquiry: ContextualInquiryFinding[];
  affinityNodes: AffinityNode[];
  workModels: WorkModel[];
  gomsAnalysis: GOMSAnalysis[];
  fittsLawData: FittsLawData[];
  links: ProjectLink[];
}

// ── Application State ──
export interface AppState {
  searchQuery: string;
  activeCategory: string | null;    // null = "All"
  activeTags: string[];
  isDarkMode: boolean;
  activeModal: string | null;       // project id or null
  isCommandPaletteOpen: boolean;
  scrollProgress: number;           // 0–1
}

// ── History (Undo/Redo) ──
export interface HistoryEntry {
  label: string;         // human-readable description, e.g. "Filtered by HCI Research"
  state: Pick<AppState, "searchQuery" | "activeCategory" | "activeTags">;
}

// ── Portfolio Data Root ──
export interface PortfolioData {
  personalInfo: PersonalInfo;
  skills: SkillCategory[];
  projects: Project[];
}
